title: Divergence + MSHR-Pressure Proxy Bundle (per-kernel-per-launch)
description: One bundle per (slug, shape_point, binary_sha256, source_commit, kernel_signature_sha256) tuple. Carries 8 named proxies covering memory-divergence and MSHR-pressure approximations the downstream model consumes. Each proxy is either a numeric admitted record or a typed-unavailable record naming the missing trace-evidence axis. One of the typed-unavailable reasons (outstanding_load_density_unavailable_no_phase_records) is pinned in the original-plan AC19 enumeration; the other seven are introduced here as round-added members of the divergence-proxies taxonomy family per the C-AC-C lockstep discipline. The bundle is emitted by tools/divergence_proxies/proxies.py and carries the sibling-sidecar `manifest_pairing_index` shape (slug, shape_point, binary_sha256, source_commit, kernel_signature_sha256) so downstream verifiers bind cached run-summary fields to on-disk bundle provenance the same way HRD / sharing-locality / order-projections / perturbation-ledger do.

schema_version.description: Bundle schema major version. Bumped from 1 to 2 in lockstep with the introduction of the required manifest_pairing_index field. A deliberate schema bump must update both this constant and consumers in lockstep.

source_commit_override_from.description: Audit annotation: the MPI source_commit value BEFORE refresh_predictor_trace_source_commit.py overwrote it. Optional; present only when the refresh utility actually rewrote the source_commit. Distinct from the bundle's top-level source_commit_override_from (which audits the trace JSON's source_commit, not the MPI's).

manifest_pairing_index.description: Bundle provenance index that pins the per-shape capture to the workload binary, source-tree commit, and kernel-signature hash. Mirrors the same shape sibling sidecars (HRD, sharing locality, order projections, perturbation ledger) emit so verify_artifacts.py can fail-closed when the bundle's provenance disagrees with the run-summary's cached source_commit.

kernel_unique_id.description: Tracer-assigned unique id for the kernel function whose launch produced this bundle. Matches the same field in the NVBit trace's per-warp records.

device.description: Compute capability tag of the device that produced the trace this bundle was computed from (e.g. sm_86, sm_120-laptop).

unique_sectors_per_warp_inst.description: Average number of distinct 32B sectors touched per warp memory instruction across the kernel launch. Required trace fields: sector-stream record's touched_32B_sectors per warp instruction. Aggregates as the arithmetic mean of touched_32B_sectors across all admitted sector-stream records for this kernel launch.

unique_lines_per_warp_inst.description: Average number of distinct 128B lines touched per warp memory instruction across the kernel launch. Required trace fields: sector-stream record's touched_128B_lines per warp instruction. Aggregates as the arithmetic mean of touched_128B_lines across all admitted sector-stream records for this kernel launch.

sectors_per_request.description: Mean per-warp memory-request sector count across the kernel launch. Equivalent to the per-warp sector_stream metric but aggregated per-launch instead of per-warp-instruction. Required trace fields: sector-stream record's sectors_per_request per warp instruction. Aggregates as the arithmetic mean across all admitted sector-stream records. The original-plan AC9 invariant pins this to 1.0 for any uniform/broadcast kernel launch.

md_loads_per_kilo_inst.description: Number of memory-divergent (touched_32B_sectors > 1) GLOBAL/LOCAL load instructions per 1000 total instructions in the kernel launch. Required trace fields: sector-stream record count + total-instruction count from threadblock proto walk. Computed as 1000 * (count of sector-stream records with touched_32B_sectors > 1) / max(1, total_instruction_count). When the trace lacks a total instruction count the proxy emits md_loads_per_kilo_inst_unavailable_no_instruction_count.

outstanding_load_density_by_phase.description: APPROXIMATION ONLY. A phase-marker-bound estimate of in-flight load density, NOT true MSHR occupancy. The proxy partitions the kernel launch into phases bounded by %clock64 / %globaltimer phase markers and reports load-launch-rate per phase. The true Miss Status Holding Register count is not observable from NVBit traces; this is a software approximation based on per-phase load issue rate. Required trace fields: phase-boundary timestamps from %clock64 phase markers + per-load timestamps. When the trace does not carry phase markers the proxy emits outstanding_load_density_unavailable_no_phase_records.

pc_repeated_miss_likely_streams.description: Count of distinct PCs (instruction program-counters) where the same PC repeatedly produces touched_32B_sectors > 1 across multiple warp invocations, suggesting a stream-style access pattern that always misses. Required trace fields: sector-stream record's PC + touched_32B_sectors per warp instruction (provenance.vpc in the consumer's in-process structure). When the trace consumer did not surface PC data the proxy emits pc_repeated_miss_likely_streams_unavailable_no_pc_data.

stride_entropy.description: Shannon entropy (in bits) of the inter-lane stride distribution across all warp memory instructions in the kernel launch. Stride between consecutive lanes' addresses is bucketed into the canonical SASS stride set {0, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, other}; the entropy reports diversity. Low entropy means uniform/broadcast (predictable); high entropy means scattered/unpredictable. Required trace fields: per-lane address vector (lane_addresses) per warp memory instruction, reconstructed via tools/nvbit_tracer/import_trace_contract.py::_reconstruct_lane_vector. When the trace did not produce reconstructable lane vectors the proxy emits stride_entropy_unavailable_no_lane_table.

throughput_saturation_slope_under_reside.description: Slope of the throughput-vs-resident-warps curve, fit by least-squares over a sweep of kernel launches at varying resident warp counts (block-size sweep). Required trace fields: per-launch resident-warp-count + per-launch effective throughput from a dedicated sweep collection. A single-launch trace cannot produce this proxy; it is always typed-unavailable in single-launch evidence. When the bundle is computed from a single-launch trace the proxy emits throughput_saturation_slope_unavailable_no_sweep.

result_kind.description: Discriminator. Pinned to `proxy_value` for the admitted branch.

value.description: The numeric proxy value. Units are documented in the per-proxy description above.

sample_count.description: Optional: number of underlying records / phases / launches that contributed to the proxy aggregation. Useful for downstream uncertainty propagation.

result_kind.description: Discriminator. Pinned to `typed_unavailable` for the rejection branch.

typed_reason.description: Member of the divergence-proxies typed-unavailable taxonomy family. One of these (outstanding_load_density_unavailable_no_phase_records) is also in the original-plan AC19 enumeration; the others are round-added per the C-AC-C lockstep discipline.
